_comment: Mission packs (Game loop architecture, Decisions, 'Mission packs', board 2026-10-31). The 5 fixed missions are the board's; every number in 'generator' is a proposal (Driving & Drift's call by the docs, written on its behalf by Game Data) for the board's playtest. A goal's kind is 'count' (shows 'n/amount') or 'seconds' (a duration, no progress shown). Trick ids are the ones TrickDetector emits (trick_detector.gd) plus thread_the_needle (thread_the_needle.gd).

generator.reason: Missions 6 to 30 are random each run (board). Amounts start near the fixed missions' level and grow in a straight line to about 2.5 times by mission 30, so the late missions are a real push but stay doable inside a 5 minute run.

goals_per_mission.reason: One goal early so a new mission stays quick to read; more goals later make late missions take longer. Each range is mission numbers (first, last) with how many goals.

tricks.reason: Starts just above the fixed 4 s drift; a drift past 10 s is hard to hold on the map.
Starts above the fixed 10; alt drifts chain quickly, so the amount can double.
A ground 360 is a deliberate move; few are asked for.
Starts above the fixed 3 s; the Jump power-up counts, so it is reachable for cars that took it.
Starts above the fixed 3; needs ramps or the Jump power-up.
The hardest air trick; the fixed mission asks for 1, so the cap stays low.
The board's own example goal is 3 needles; it depends on the map's gaps, so the cap is modest.
